draft.text: You came in for your annual exam and to talk about your sleep problems.
You have trouble sleeping well and feel stressed from traveling and adjusting to new places.
You are experiencing insomnia, which is making it hard for you to sleep through the night and feel rested.
We will keep track of your sleep patterns and symptoms.
You will try to keep a regular bedtime routine and avoid stimulating activities before bed.
You will also keep a sleep diary and follow up in a few weeks.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you're having trouble sleeping well.
You feel stressed from traveling and adjusting to new places.
You've tried melatonin and meditation but haven't felt better.
You wake up often at night and feel tired when you wake up.
You're experiencing insomnia, which is making it hard for you to sleep well and feel rested.
We'll keep checking on your sleep patterns.
You'll try to keep a regular bedtime routine and avoid stimulating activities before bed.
You'll also track your sleep in a diary and come back in a few weeks to see how you're doing.
